{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the premises
# Premise 1: Are there NEW customers reached via PAID SEARCH?
new_paid_search = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check if any such rows exist

converted_fraction = new_paid_search['converted'].mean()

# Print the result
print("Number of NEW customers reached via PAID SEARCH:", len(new_paid_search))
print("Converted fraction:", converted_fraction)

# Return the fraction as a float
converted_fraction"}
